name: scholion
description: Local second-opinion support for individuals and clinicians — genome (VCF), laboratory history, prescriptions and wearables. One person per container and per assistant conversation; the tools use the active container and cannot switch it. Findings carry their evidence level; lower-evidence findings reach the assistant as labelled hypotheses, not conclusions. The engine must be installed locally. Tool answers may reach the host's model provider. Not a medical device.
